headline: NYY @ BOS matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is NYY 4.27 at BOS 3.48, with a projected total of 7.75. Movement read: Both offenses moved down (NYY -0.27, BOS -0.24), so the movement points more toward run suppression than a clearer side. The projected total fell -0.51, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Jake Bennett has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Paul Goldschmidt, Caleb Durbin, Ceddanne Rafaela, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Max Schuemann, Mickey Gasper because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
